Changelog:
# Should I? v1.1.4

Small **Should I Sell?** owned-items quality-of-life update.

## Owned Items location filter
- Adds **All locations**, **Player inventory**, **All retainers**, and individual cached retainers by name.
- Uses structured ownership data rather than parsing location labels.
- Player inventory includes player inventory and saddlebags; retainer scope includes cached retainer inventory and market holdings.
- When a location is selected, the **Qty** column shows the quantity in that scope and quantity sorting follows the scoped amount.
- Sell score, pricing and stack guidance still model the full known position so filtering the table does not silently change the economics.
- Reset Filters also resets the location filter.
